subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class I

source.read: SCERT Tamil Nadu, TNCF 2017 syllabus, English language, Standards 1 to 10 (published in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette), read through a copy hosted by an exam-coaching site
source.note: UNOFFICIAL COPY OF AN OFFICIAL SOURCE. The state's own syllabus (TNCF 2017, marked draft), read through a text summary of a third-party copy of the gazette pages; the Standard 9 page was only partly readable. The Samacheer Kalvi textbooks follow it term by term.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Recognises the names of everyday objects and people when heard.

outcomes.note: Tap-this-then-that instructions are practised by ear; classroom instructions are not.
Short passages are heard with questions; rhymes are not sung in the app.

outcomes.text: Hears beginning sounds, rhyming words and syllables.
outcomes.note: Syllables are practised; rhyme and beginning sounds are not taught on their own.

outcomes.text: Says rhymes, greets, and uses please, thank you and sorry.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Speaks in short sentences of three or four words.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Links letters with sounds and reads simple three-letter words and sight words.
outcomes.note: Words are heard and matched with pictures; sounding out letters is not taught on its own.

outcomes.text: Understands short texts with the help of pictures.
Writes capital and small letters, copies words and writes own name.
outcomes.note: Done with a grown-up, away from the app, who ticks what they saw.

outcomes.text: Writes short words, spelling them as they sound.
Uses naming words, action words and describing words.
Uses in, on, at and below, and and or.
Uses a, an, this and that, and I, you, he and she.
Uses was and were, and the present continuous.
Knows words for things, people, animals, colours, shapes, numbers, days and months.
